fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and political coverage of the 1949 Miami municipal election, including a front-page attack on the Dade County grand jury report as politically motivated by the Miami "Crime Commission" and local daily newspapers. Includes polling/horse-race election notes and discussion of candidates such as H. Leslie Quigg, Palmer, Thomson, Wolfarth, Bandel, and Dunn. Additional articles cover the proposed Miami sewage disposal plant (radio address by Perrine Palmer, Jr.), aviation safety concerns near the airport, local civic and labor issues, and brief news items and advertisements.
